findings.rootCause: custom state mutators bypassed the terminal transition guard
findings.productionFix: terminal records now return unchanged from custom lifecycle mutators

findings.rootCause: a declared source hash was ignored when the raw artifact did not yet exist
findings.productionFix: new artifacts verify supplied content against the declared SHA-256 before writing

findings.rootCause: lexical path checks allowed context artifacts to traverse symlinked directories
findings.productionFix: context persistence and retrieval reject symlink traversal

findings.rootCause: concurrent completion callers could both observe a pending sidecar before either persisted SENT
findings.productionFix: completion notification dispatch is serialized by an operation-scoped lock

findings.rootCause: known structured validator adapters treated malformed stdout as an empty finding set
findings.productionFix: OpenGrep, Trivy, Playwright, and Pact evidence shape is validated before PASS

findings.rootCause: the scenario inventory assertion ignored an explicitly configured reproduction seed
findings.suiteFix: scenario assertions now accept the documented AEH_SCENARIO_SEED override

knownLimitations: Real Paseo/model-backed start success cannot be exercised in the current environment because managed Paseo is unavailable.
Opt-in real provider contracts remain environment-gated by AEH_RUN_REAL_PROVIDERS=1.
Podman-heavy, mutation, and signed Cosign lanes require their external tools and are not claimed as executed here.
